summary: Per-frame AI steering target computation. Reads the 5-lane speed-limit table (this+0x4358), folds min/max boundaries, evaluates each of 5 nearby AI candidates via spatial nearest-neighbor queries, scores and insertion-sorts the five best targets, then selects a steering/lane result with overtaking state transitions and track-parameter speed clamps. Called each frame from AIMainUpdate.

operations.description: Load own-vehicle setup pointer at this+0x4354 and read its boundary-speed parameters at +0x50 (left) and +0x84 (right).
Scan the 5-lane speed-limit table at this+0x4358 (each slot has left-bound at +0x50 and right-bound at +0x54), folding the running max of right-bound and min of left-bound.
Read own-car AI status through the vehicle pointer at this+0x4174: pit/status flag at +0x32C8 and track-speed field at +0x4354, used to gate lane scoring.
Read vtable object via *(this+0x0); overtake-allowance counters at obj+0x48A4 (left) and obj+0x48A8 (right) gate lane restriction decisions.
Load track-local lane offsets (this+0x34E0/E4/E8), RenderZ this+0x34F8, forward-direction vector this+0x34FC and lateral-direction vector this+0x3500 for candidate evaluation.

For each of 5 AI candidates (stride-17 dword slots anchored at this+0x4174, slot data at this+0x41A4..0x41B4): spatial nearest-neighbor search over tree at global 0x5EA2C0, BVH fallback when the candidate is the own car; compute gap/time via ShortComputation_3ca0/_3db0 and VehicleDynamics on target and self; record the nearest-slot index into this+0x42C8 table region.

Insertion-sort the five best candidate scores (v180..v184 with slot indices v185..v189), scoring derived from lane gap, reference-speed fields (this+0x4414..0x4428), clamped by the 0x4488 flag and lane-block flags 0x454C/0x4550.

Per-candidate overtake decision: read candidate setup struct (heading at +0xB8, wrapped to +/-pi), lateral offset, lane-availability thresholds, and speed clamps via TrackParameterMinimumClamp; gated by the distance constants dbl_8AFEA0 < flt_8ACF90 + 6.5/2.5 and half-track-width flt_5EA3FC.
Lane-target selection via SignedIndexTableLookup on candidate lateral offsets; steering fallbacks (550/400-distance penalties) weighted by the overtake-allowance counters from the obj vtable.

Overtaking state machine: call Overtaking(this, mode) for modes 2/7 and 1/8; update overtake counters (this+0x4544/0x4548), lane-clamp fields, and transition candidate slot states (3/4/7/8) written to this+0x42D4/0x42D8/0x42DC.

Commit final steering: clamp result (this+0x440C) between lane bounds (this+0x4414/0x4418), override with forced targets this+0x4420 or this+0x4424 when set, set wall-collision flag this+0x4140 when steering exceeds a track boundary, then clear the 0x4488 state flag.
Gate: lane-restriction flags this+0x454C == 1 (guard 1) and this+0x4550 == 1 (guard 2) enable candidate edge/collision behaviors.
Read the AI tuning-constant cluster at 0x59E430..0x59E964 used by the candidate scoring and speed-clamp math.

clean_pseudocode: for (lane in 5 lanes at this+0x4358): fold min_left = max(min_left, lane->left); max_right = min(max_right, lane->right);
score = time_to_gap(cand, target); insert into sorted top-5;
for (i in top-5): decide steering_mode (1/2/3/4/7/8/16) via lane gap, overtake counters, speed clamps;
this->steering(0x440C) = clamp(selected); set wall flag 0x4140 if out of bounds; clear 0x4488;
unresolved: Exact role of the 0x59E430..0x59E964 constant cluster in the score formula is not mapped instruction-by-instruction.
The obj vtable fields at +0x48A4/+0x48A8 are read as overtake-allowance counters but their write sites are external.
Candidate-slot table at this+0x42C8/0x42D4/0x42D8/0x42DC region has fields not individually enumerated in the packet.
